name: Dai-ichi Karkaria Limited
summary: Dai-Ichi Karkaria Limited focuses on the development and worldwide distribution of specialized chemical products. These chemicals are critical for numerous industries, such as paints, coatings, and pigments, the petroleum sector, various industrial uses, and the creation of home and personal care items. Furthermore, their product range, which includes polyacrylamides, supports operations in construction, textile treatment, paper and pulp manufacturing, water and environmental management, sugar processing, mining, mineral refinement, and metallurgy. The company was founded on May 13, 1960, with its main offices located in Mumbai, India.
